title: auto-advance acceptance does not refresh the published graph view
wanted_capability: A graph-carrying publication accepted by the auto-advance policy should serve its graphs immediately. Observed at 18585c6e: candidate accepted (publisher status shows the new generation and commit), yet bbox_project_graph_list/_validate kept serving the PRIOR accepted generation (stale accepted_generation and accepted_commit in the validate report), with no "published graph view refresh failed" warning logged, until a daemon restart's boot reconcile installed the correct view. Either publisher_auto_advance's refresh_published_graph_views call reads the pre-swap pointer (race) or its install does not reach the read path; the operator-advance path may share it. Boot reconcile (efca7a75) masks it only across restarts.
fallback_used: Pod roll after graph-carrying merges; boot reconcile installs the accepted view.
evidence: src/server/knowledge_view.rs:1571-1599 (refresh loads runtime.load_verified; failure would warn, none logged)
live 2026-08-16: accepted 67f5ee06 at 063430d4; validate served 4115bb64 at f3c84a45 until restart; post-restart boot reconcile served the accepted 148-vertex graph
